run_grammar_constrained_generation: run grammar-constrained text generation using a LLaMA model and an EBNF Japanese grammar file
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar string with unicode support for a tokenizer
build_grammar_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor from an IncrementalGrammarConstraint to enforce grammar rules during generation
generate_with_logits_processor: generate text using model.generate with a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to constrain output to a grammar
decode_batched_tokens: decode batched token IDs back to text strings using tokenizer.batch_decode with skip_special_tokens
